messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — Acme CISO asked for our incident response bullets to include in the POC slide deck. They want (1) customer notification window, (2) regulator timing, (3) what we commit contractually. Need a short, customer-friendly version + a legal-safe fallback.
sophia_security: Quick rundown: initial acknowledgement to affected customers within 24h of confirmed impact; regulator notifications follow applicable law (eg GDPR 72h); preliminary update at ~72h; full RCA + remediation plan within 30 days. Keep it high level for sales. :white_check_mark:
ivan_engineering: From runtime side we can supply detection timestamps, sanitized logs, and a timeline of actions. For POC please say "sanitized timeline" to avoid sharing PII.
alex_sales: Can we promise 24h in a slide? or should we hedge?
linda_legal: Don't hardcode absolute guarantees in marketing. Suggest wording: `We typically notify affected customers within 24 hours of confirming impact; exact timing is governed by contract and applicable law.` That keeps it accurate and defensible.
sophia_security: Agreed. For enterprise buyers we also offer custom notify windows in Dedicated/Private contracts (can map to SLAs).
jess_ops: Add ops mechanics: containment within hours (isolation + failover to safe model variant), short-term mitigation steps, and post-incident follow-up cadence. Also note we can integrate with customer IR contacts.
alex_sales: Need a one-slide snippet and a 1‑liner for the deck. Can someone paste both?
sophia_security: Slide copy (short):
```
Incident response (POC / Enterprise)
• Initial acknowledgement to affected customers: typically within 24 hours of confirmed impact
• Regulatory notifications: as required by law (eg GDPR 72 hours)
• Preliminary update: ~72 hours
• Full RCA & remediation plan: within 30 days (or sooner for critical events)
• Escalation: ops@redwood.com; named CISO contact provided in contract
```
jess_ops: 1-liner for slide header: `Fast, transparent incident response — initial customer notice typically within 24 hours; full RCA within 30 days.`
ivan_engineering: For the POC we can attach a redacted timeline example and a sample sanitized log export. Will prep two files: `poctimeline_redacted.csv` + `pocexecutive_summary.pdf`.
alex_sales: Perfect. Sophia, Linda — any mandatory clauses I should avoid putting in the public POC deck?
sophia_security: Avoid specifics about forensic tooling, internal thresholds, or exact containment commands. Those leak runbook detail.
linda_legal: Also avoid promising regulator actions or admissions of fault. Use "notify" and "coordinate with customers and regulators as required" phrasing.
incident_bot: runbook-update: IR runbook v4.2 published to https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ir — see change log.
alex_sales: Awesome — I'll update the POC slides with jess_ops wording + Sophia's slide block. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
sophia_security: Dropping a short snippet you can paste into docs (copy below):
"We prioritize rapid, transparent communication. We typically notify affected customers within 24 hours after confirming impact, provide preliminary updates within ~72 hours, and deliver a full RCA and remediation plan within 30 days. Exact timelines are governed by contract and applicable laws"
alex_sales: Copied, will include and tag legal for final sign-off before sending to buyer.
linda_legal: Happy to sign off once you send the slide draft.
ivan_engineering: I'll upload the redacted timeline artifacts to the POC workspace by EOD.
jess_ops: FYI — for Dedicated customers we also support direct webhook notifications to customer IR endpoints. Add a small footnote if relevant.
alex_sales: Noted. Closing thread after slides land. Thank you!"
